title: Subsea control system
goal: Show redundant subsea control-pod paths with their common hydraulic supply.

rubric.must: A left-to-right reliability path visibly represents subsea control success path.
The drawing visibly shows two complete control-pod paths visibly arranged in parallel.
The drawing visibly shows common hydraulic unit and tree actuator as series blocks.
Every component block visibly displays its reliability value.
Input and output terminals visibly bracket the success path.
A computed system-reliability summary is visible on the drawing.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/rbd/ideal.svg (sha256 1f4f1225b103), source sha256 7e75508f5676. Independent recursive series/parallel drawing with all source blocks, separate complete redundant paths, reliability totals and Birnbaum importance computed from the success expression. Red borders mark actual single points of failure; highest importance uses green (inner border when both roles apply). All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
